description: This file defines a helper class for logging, particularly designed to facilitate flexible logging via linked LogNode objects, and provides convenience methods for different log levels and message types.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class providing static logging methods and constants, acting as a wrapper and manager for LogNode chains in Android development.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode at the head of the logger chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode chain to which log messages will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Dispatches logs with specified priority, tag, message, and optional exception to the LogNode chain.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a verbose message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a debug message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs an info message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a warning message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs an error message, optionally with an exception.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a wtf (assert) message, optionally with an exception.
